svg.title: 34. Long inner thigh rock back — female orange flat color illustration
svg.desc: Start on your hands and knees. Extend one leg out to the side with that foot on the floor. Keep your back long and move your hips towards the bent leg heel.
svg.metadata: Created with built-in image generation using the approved orange female illustration as character and style reference. Converted to curved SVG paths with VTracer. Exercise guide source: https://theprehabguys.com/vimeo-video/quadruped-dynamic-long-adductor-stretch/
